entities.name: PMID:25086587
observations: In mice, κ-opioid receptor knockout almost completely abolished nitrous oxide antinociception; nitrous-oxide hypnotic potentiation remained intact.

entities.name: PMID:20157832
observations: In mice, the κ-selective antagonist nor-binaltorphimine significantly suppressed nitrous oxide antinociception, whereas the δ-selective antagonist did not.

entities.name: PMID:2157601
observations: Intracerebroventricular or intrathecal nor-binaltorphimine reduced nitrous oxide analgesia in mice, supporting supraspinal and spinal κ-receptor involvement.

entities.name: OPRK1
observations: κ-opioid receptor; knockout and selective-antagonist mouse evidence implicates it in nitrous oxide antinociception.

entities.name: Nitrous oxide
observations: In mouse pain-behavior tests, antinociceptive action is nearly abolished by κ-opioid receptor deletion and attenuated by selective κ-receptor blockade.
